# Run a Service Lifecycle Action

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `command.service.action` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/command.yaml` |
| Tags | command |

Invokes a service definition (tagged `service`) with the given
lifecycle verb. The service definition routes the verb to its
backend's lifecycle wrapper (docker compose up/down/..., launchd
start/stop/...).
Wired as `localfabric service action <service_id> <action>` on the CLI
and as POST /v1/service/action on the API surface (Phase C3).
